items.quote: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
items.claim: In Exodus 16:4 the LORD tells Moses he will rain bread from heaven. The people are to gather a set amount each day, and this daily rule is described as a way to test whether they will obey his law.
items.action: rain bread from heaven and set a daily gathering rule
items.mechanism: Collecting a fixed amount each day acts as a test of whether the people will follow his law
